_comment: Optional 4th-band upgrade: adds a second 6 GHz capture at the TOP of the band (UNII-8, ch 207: 6905-7065 MHz, center 6985) alongside the low 6 GHz channel (ch 15, center 6025). Needs a 4th AX210 on the RX host and a second 6E/7 AP pinned to ch 207 (one AP radio serves only one 6 GHz channel). Use the per-band ablation in `wispec.train eval` to check whether 6g_hi adds information over 6g.
